units.source_text: 在神社办公室正门前，我求了释签。

en.t: In front of the main entrance to the shrine office, I asked for an oracle slip.

units.source_text: 一个似于厨房洗涮活计的中年妇女，

en.t: A middle-aged woman who seemed to do kitchen washing work,

units.source_text: 一边不停地用脱下来的围裙指拭着手，一边走了过来，

en.t: came walking over while constantly wiping her hands on the apron she had taken off,

units.source_text: 毫无表情地接过我按规定送过去的十元钱。

en.t: and expressionlessly accepted the ten yuan that I handed over as required.
